```sql
WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    'POINT (-86.0041 37.132939)'::geography AS geometry,
    'Kentucky Action Park'::text AS park_name
),
county_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    r.geometry
  FROM 
    regions r
  WHERE 
    r.region_name ILIKE 'Barren County' AND 
    r.addr_state ILIKE 'KY'
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast, 
      1, 
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM park_geom)::geography, 
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast, 
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM park_geom)::geometry
    )
),
county_avg_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1)), 2) AS avg_elevation
  FROM 
    dem_clip
)
SELECT 
  park_name,
  ROUND(ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1), 2) AS park_elevation,
  avg_elevation
FROM 
  dem_clip,
  park_geom,
  county_avg_elevation
WHERE 
  ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1) > avg_elevation;
```
